screens.home:
Cashback Analyzer
Send a screenshot right away or choose an action.
screens.help:
Help
Send a screenshot or text lines like "Fuel 5%". You can also ask: "best cashback for restaurants" or "delete bank T-Bank".
screens.choose_bank:
Choose Bank
Select a bank from the list or provide your own.
screens.attach_bank:
Attach Categories
Choose where to save these cashback categories for {target_month}.
screens.enter_bank_name:
Bank Name
Enter your bank/card label.
screens.manual_prompt:
Manual Input
Send one category per line, for example:
Fuel 5%
Restaurants - 7%
screens.photo_prompt:
Photo Input
Send a screenshot with cashback categories.
screens.ask_item_percent:
Percent
Enter a value from 0 to 100.

messages.landing_feature_capture: Upload screenshots right from the home screen without stepping through extra menus.
messages.landing_feature_months: Store separate cashback sets for previous, current, and next month.
messages.landing_feature_channels: Use web and Telegram on top of the same application core.
messages.workflow_step_capture: Send a screenshot or paste cashback lines manually.
messages.workflow_step_review: Check OCR output, switch bank or month, and fix categories if needed.
messages.workflow_step_save: Save the final set and return to it later.
messages.next_step_upload: Send a screenshot or photo with cashback categories.
messages.next_step_manual: Paste the categories line by line and submit them in one step.
messages.next_step_choose_bank: Choose the bank that should receive the parsed categories.
messages.next_step_review_save: Review the categories, adjust them if needed, and save.
messages.next_step_edit_saved: Open the target month, then update or remove categories.
messages.next_step_navigation: Pick the next action from the structured sections below.
messages.manual_input_hint: You can paste several lines at once, for example Fuel 5%, Restaurants 7%, Taxi 3%.
messages.percent_input_hint: Enter numbers only, for example 7 or 7.5.
messages.text_input_hint: If it is easier, type one line and submit the form.
messages.no_ranking_data: Not enough data to build ranking.
messages.reminder_monthly: Don't forget to update your cashback categories for the new month.
messages.web_login_hint: Sign in with Telegram and manage cashback categories from phone or desktop.
messages.web_auth_hint: Sign in with a local account. Telegram remains available as an optional linked identity.
messages.upload_hint: Upload a screenshot from your banking app. Crop extra regions for better OCR.
messages.ocr_hint: Hint: crop the screenshot, increase contrast, and try again.
messages.confirm_discard_draft:
You have unsaved changes.
Choose what to do before going to {target}.
